parts.text: (c) The student determines the distance a between the centre of block Q and the 50.0 cm mark and also the distance b between the centre of block Q and the pivot. He repeats the procedure for positions of block Q at the 90.0 cm, 85.0 cm, 80.0 cm and 75.0 cm marks. His results are shown in Table 1.1.
